interpretation_boundary.conditional_population: Any valid counterfactual fractions describe the preregistered reference-ready target cohort, not pre-ready disagreement targets.
interpretation_boundary.eligibility: A target enters counterfactual numerators and denominators only after the preregistered prior-reference pool is ready. Early excluded targets are counted only in eligibility coverage.
interpretation_boundary.reference: Per-target median mirror_mean and mirror_concentration use only prior same-case oracle-noise non-disagreement frames after the fixed warmup.
